title: Astra-Singularity Dynamic Core: An interactive graviton node that manifests at sector intersections, physically pulsing gravitational wave rings outward to magnetically pull cursor reticles and bend inscribed particle beams toward its epicenter.
author_role: Principal Systems & Economy Architect (Data schemas, progression curves, state ledgers)
summary: Implements an orbital Astra-Singularity node at lattice intersections that exerts inverse-square magnetic pull on reticles and warps sigil particle trajectories.
technical_specification: Initialize `state.world.singularity = { active: true, x: 400, y: 310, targetX: 400, targetY: 310, pulsePhase: 0, strength: 1.0, eventHorizonRadius: 42 }`. On each frame, `pulsePhase = (pulsePhase + dt * 2.4) % (Math.PI * 2)`. Compute pull on `state.pointer`: `dx = singularity.x - pointer.x`, `dy = singularity.y - pointer.y`, `dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy)`. If `dist < 260 && dist > 8`, offset pointer visual tracking by `(dx / dist) * (singularity.strength * 480 / (dist + 40)) * dt`. Update existing particle arrays (`state.world.particles`), bending velocity vectors toward singularity using `a = G / (dist^1.5)` clamped to 400 px/s².
acceptance_criteria: Cursor visual reticle drifts tangibly toward the singularity intersection when within 260px radius without desyncing canvas logic coords.
Emitted sigil spark particles curve smoothly around the core instead of traveling in rigid linear paths.
